title: Magnolia Gardens template compliance vs KRS 194A.713(14)
prompt:
Magnolia Gardens is reviewing its General Resident Agreement Template for compliance with KRS 194A.713(14). Review the template and that provision, and determine whether compliance with KRS 194A.713(14) can be confirmed.

The template states that a copy of resident’s rights is attached and incorporated by reference. That material is not available for review. Do not assume what it contains.

Reply in a short paragraph explaining your reasoning.
